mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_processing_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY') AND not_before <= #{now} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE material_processing_job SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, fence_token = fence_token + 1, attempt = attempt + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY') AND not_before <= #{now}
UPDATE material_processing_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND fence_token = #{fenceToken}
